method: Frames are 256px grid cells (0 = whole image). Opaque means alpha >= 230; group shares count opaque pixels within RGB distance 32 of any group colour; lavender band means hue 235-290 deg, saturation >= 0.25 and lightness 0.45-0.92 (catches paler lilac, but also purple costume); periwinkle band means hue 200-235 deg, saturation >= 0.15 and lightness 0.45-0.92 (bluer tails, but also blue costume); pink-purple band means hue 290-345 deg with the same saturation and lightness limits as lavender (tail or pink top); vivid means saturation >= 0.6 and lightness 0.3-0.8; dark edge means a silhouette-edge pixel with luma below 90.
